Project description
YOLO identifies delivery vehicles, civilian crowds, or roadblocks. NVIDIA Cosmos interprets the overall scene safety or the urgency of the structural damage. Semantic search allows aid coordinators to query massive, chaotic video logs for specific logistical needs.

hasPart.name: Technical architecture
hasPart.description: YOLO identifies delivery vehicles, civilian crowds, or roadblocks. NVIDIA Cosmos interprets the overall scene safety or the urgency of structural damage. Cosmos Embed1 indexes segments into VastDB. Semantic search allows aid coordinators to query video logs for specific logistical needs via a Flask-based Mission Ops UI. The app uses VSS APIs to surface insights and Weights & Biases LLMs to synthesize operational briefs based on targeted video segments.

hasPart.name: Setup instructions
hasPart.description: Clone the repository: git clone https://github.com/drokandrii/disasteranalyzer Navigate to the tools/disaster-logistics/ directory. Ensure your Kubernetes environment is configured with the necessary secrets (VSS_URL, VSS_USERNAME, VSS_PASSWORD) either via a Secret or /config/ .config. Deploy the Flask app to the /app path using the provided K8s manifests. The app resolves FOCAL_VIDEO (20261017_131332_3cc5783a.mp4) on startup and locks all searches and agent actions to this ground-truth asset.

hasPart.name: Lessons learned
hasPart.description: Strict Scoping is Essential: Hard-locking the application architecture to a single source of truth (FOCAL_VIDEO) at the API layer prevented cross-corpus contamination and kept the UI strictly mission-focused. Specialized Prompting: Using a highly specific, logistics-focused prompt (max 800 characters) during the re-ingestion phase with Cosmos3-Reason was the key to transforming generic visual descriptions into actionable, structured data (e.g., identifying "smoke near road" or "vehicle convoy").
